title: Recursive self-improvement
description: Process where AI repeatedly improves itself
extract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) is a hypothetical process in which an artificial intelligence (AI) system iteratively designs a more capable successor. It is claimed that this may trigger an intelligence explosion, where such iterative improvements cause ever more capable AI systems, potentially resulting in the creation of an artificial superintelligence. As of 2026, various RSI-related projects are ongoing and AI companies are increasingly using AI for coding and research, but human work is still needed.
